channel.title: Counter & Crumb
channel.description: Question-shaped buying guides, side-by-side comparisons and a fully sourced product register for countertop air fryers and kitchen thermometers. Every outbound link is marked sponsored; every claim carries a source.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two shapes of air fryer, two completely different kitchens. The decision is not about which one is newer — it is about how much counter you own and how many people you feed.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quart figures, basket numbers and marketing names all blur together. Here is the short list that actually changes which machine you should buy.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs people underestimate. They are also the two that decide whether an air fryer gets used twice a week or once a month.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: A twenty-four preset machine is a promise. These are the questions that find out whether the machine does what it says, before the box is open.

item.title: Do you need a wireless meat thermometer, or is a probe enough?
item.description: Two thermometers in this register answer the same question in two different ways. The deciding question is how many things you are cooking at once.

item.title: How accurate does a meat thermometer need to be, and what does 'accurate' even mean?
item.description: A tolerance is not a measurement, and a number on a box is not a promise. Here is how to read an accuracy claim properly.
